_doc: Six enemy families mirroring the classes (Documentation/CORE_DESIGN_PASS_2026-11-17.md, D8.1). Presentation and matchups only: an enemy's stat profile still comes from its archetype (Enemies.json), so nothing here changes balance. archetypes = the archetypes that read as this family; beastWhenNoHands = a Berserker without hands is a Beast. playsLike / punishedBy are in hero words; punishedByClasses / punishesClasses drive the dungeon-select matchup marks. fernis = his matchup line, the opposite of good advice (D9.7). All text REVIEW.

families.name: Brute
families.fernis: Brutes ahead. Drop the shield, you'll want both hands free to apologize.

families.name: Knight
families.fernis: Knights. Wear your heaviest armor and don't bother with fire, trust me.

families.name: Assassin
families.fernis: Assassins. Take your time with the long spells, they love waiting.

families.name: Sage
families.playsLike: builds up, then casts long chains
families.fernis: Sages in there. Let them finish their chains, it's only polite.

families.name: Trickster
families.fernis: Tricksters. Swing wild, accuracy is overrated.

families.name: Beast
families.fernis: Beasts. They love a good stab, go cuddle one.
